turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm seventy and studying for an amateur radio licence. My brain isn't what it used to be.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a great thing to take on. What's the hardest part so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The electronics. Ohms and volts and all that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's where most people struggle. Try thinking of it like water in pipes. Voltage is the pressure, current is how much flows.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, that does make it easier.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: And resistance is how narrow the pipe is. Once that picture clicks, the formulas make more sense.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: three times and still forget it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try explaining it out loud to someone, or even to the dog. Teaching it helps more than copying it.
